name: SiT-S/2 unconditional branch / CFG 0.0

sources.cfgs: User requested adding CFG 0.0 to the existing SiT comparison.
sources.methods_nfes: User requested DPM-Solver++ and UniPC at NFE 5, 6, 8, 10.
sources.seed: guided-diffusion/sample.py:22 default --seed=1234; user requested the ImageNet256 sampling reference.
sources.batch_size: Reuse successful SiT sampling batches on the same GPU/model/precision/order; reuse smaller proven batches only on actual OOM. No per-NFE search.
sources.precision: FP32 network and feature extraction preserve the validated ADM Inception parity; FP64 moments.
sources.order_num_samples: User selected RBF-Solver conditional ImageNet256 protocol: order 2, 10,000 per condition.
sources.time_interval: Original DPM/UniPC defaults: t_start=schedule.T=1, t_end=1/total_N=1/1000; dpm_solver.py:1245-1248 also recommends 1e-3 for continuous low-NFE. SiT ICPlan time s=1-t. No additional start truncation.
sources.sampler: Exact copies of guided-diffusion/samplers/{rbf_solver,uni_pc,dpm_solver}.py; order 2, multistep, time_uniform, lower_order_final=True, denoise_to_zero=False.
sources.rbf: Fit CFG 0.0 targets and shapes with the existing approved target/optimization protocol.
sources.gpu_usage: 사용자 지정: GPU 0과 1을 모두 사용. 공용 작업 대기열에서 작업을 배정.
sources.input_pairing: 배치 크기가 달라도 동일 샘플 ID에는 동일 초기 노이즈와 클래스를 사용하여 비교 조건을 유지.
sources.adapter: SiT ICPlan x=s*data+(1-s)*noise, v=data-noise => x0=x+(1-s)*v. UniPC BH2 source linear-system limit at old lambda=-infinity is evaluated analytically in sampling.py; original vendor files unchanged. endpoint_validation.json passed.
sources.conditioning: SiT paper section 3.3: null-label velocity. Evaluate the null label directly on all four latent channels; do not leave the fourth channel conditional through forward_with_cfg.

batch_tuning.scope: Complete sampling, VAE decoding and GPU FID path with all persistent allocations present.
batch_tuning.search: Find the largest passing integer batch with CUDA OOM boundary checks; cap at remaining requested samples.

input_pairing: Reuse saved initial noise by sample ID; stored class labels are ignored and replaced by null label for CFG 0.0.
